claims.title: A partial-prefix determinant twist is a rank-one update
claims.statement: For r distinct selected vector rows and every prefix or arbitrary letter subset S′, the generic conjugate cocharacter changes the selected matrix by a rank-one update. Its determinant is affine in t with minimum exponent <=1. Hence val_S′(D_A^m H)<=val_S′(H)+m, including the zero case.
assumptions: Any coefficient field, r>0, distinct chosen vector letters; no characteristic-zero or infinite-field assumption.
claims.source_relation: This supplies a direct proof of the second clause of FieldMultidegreeDivisibility. That interface is a conclusion here, not a hypothesis.

claims.title: Generic singular specialization forces all determinant powers integrally
claims.statement: For a letter-multihomogeneous polynomial, minimum prefix weight theta exceeding the degree B in other selected vector letters forces D_A^(theta−B) divisibility over every field. The proof uses the generic determinant prime and a kernel-adapted cocharacter; quotient degree and OR1 permit iteration. Unit-leading-coefficient division descends the quotient to every integral domain, preserving all prefix bounds.
assumptions: Finite signed letter family over a field, or an integral domain after fraction-field extension.
All chosen determinant rows are distinct vectors lying in the division subset; F is letter-multihomogeneous.
claims.source_relation: Proves the previously abstract hE input itself. The generic determinant irreducibility proof is included and works in every characteristic; the integral descent does not require the base domain to be a UFD.

claims.title: Overlapping tasks and the literal segment divisor
claims.statement: A finite list of determinant tasks of total exponent T can be extracted if every initial task prefix has minimum at least its other-vector degree plus T. Each quotient has weakly smaller degrees and every prefix loses at most T. For actual segments the tasks are one recent-r-even determinant per late letter plus the preceding-frame determinant; their total cost is <=mStar, and their quotient satisfies exactly MGen0.
assumptions: The exact Valid frame, even positive n′, r,K>0, and a late letter.
The per-task strict-prefix valuation inequality; OR4–OR5 supply it in the actual application.
claims.source_relation: The old-frame task uses a prefix containing only those r rows and hence has other-vector degree zero. All selected rows lie inside the segment; no default Arow branch is used. This proves dv_segment rather than merely invoking its hE premise.

claims.title: The actual one-sided other-vector degree is at most Bo/80
claims.statement: Every even predecessor outside the r nearest ones is before the oldest of them and lies in the old frame or intermediate letter set. Its even distance is 2h for a distinct h>=1. The one-sided total-degree upper bound gives other degree <=2.02 Bo/(p^2−1)<=Bo/80 for p>=13, with no lower approximation assumption.
assumptions: p>=13, even positive n′, r>=2, Valid frame; a<=deg_s<=2a on TT.
Only d_y<=1.01 levDeg(y) on old-frame and intermediate letters is assumed.
claims.source_relation: The finite sum is bounded by the full geometric series over distinct positive even distances. This proves the outgoing RestGeomU version, not just the absolute-error RestGeom statement.

claims.title: Explicit C>=100 extraction margin for the actual data
claims.statement: From the exact mStar definition, alphaMax<=1+rkQ, N1<=k and r,k>=2, one has mStar<=8rk²QcP. The actual size bound a>=Ck³r²NQ⁵cPY and oldest degree Bo>=a/Q imply mStar<=Bo/100 for C>=100. The exact floor slack is <=Bo/8, so Bo/2−sl>=Bo/80+mStar. Thus every actual MGen factors through Dv and MGen0.
assumptions: r,k>=2, Y>=r, N>=1, Q>=1, cP>=1, N1<=k, alphaMax<=1+rkQ.
Valid frame span z_j−f_(j−1,0)<=G′ and Q=p^G′.
a>=Ck³r²NQ⁵cPY with C>=100 and a<=deg_s<=2a on TT.
claims.source_relation: This supplies the exact actual application with an explicit constant and weaker needed margin. It does not claim an optimized universal OneSidedLemma4 constant triple. No mStar<=sl premise or dropped floor is used.

claims.title: Whole-letter projection gives RestModel and integral quotient symbols
claims.statement: Projecting the defining XX′ product span to fixed whole-letter degrees gives a finite integral sum of exact MGen products: generic substitution preserves each letter degree and its prefix bounds. The final order-support intersection is only forgotten for this inclusion. OR5 and completed IP6/IP11 then give xi=Dv xi′ with phi(xi′) in the actual symbol algebra.
assumptions: The exact XX′ membership and whole-letter homogeneity of the outgoing xi family.
The already reconstructed integral path-generator spanning and image statements IP6/IP11.
claims.source_relation: No integral irreducible decomposition or termwise factorization of the final XX′ support intersection is asserted. The inclusion into MGen follows directly from homogeneous projection.

claims.title: The literal RestPh congruence and residual exponent arithmetic
claims.statement: Universal Frobenius determinant congruence modulo p and the binomial split give phi(Dseg_x)^m1 divisible modulo p^c by D_barx^(m1−c), and similarly the old-frame factor. Late intervals cover each TT residue once; cyclic frame reindexing and m1−c=(2Q+3)c+kQ, m2−c=c(alphaMax+1) yield product phi(Dv)=fixedSymbolFactor(c) DkQ H+p^cY with H integral tangential and Y integral.
assumptions: The exact Ctx frame/chart/coefficients, any nonnegative c, and m1/m2 as defined.
Frobenius is used as a ring endomorphism modulo p; no arbitrary coefficient is asserted fixed under it.
claims.source_relation: This proves the actual outgoing multiplier identity. It keeps the p^c error and nonnegative residual powers c(alphaMax−alpha_j); it is not replaced by the ordinary SPtrue multiplier assertion.

claims.title: Actual monPh symbols have the required integral separated realization
claims.statement: Combining quotient symbols and RestPh gives monPh=Z fixedSymbolFactor(c)+p^cY′ with Z in the key-symbol algebra and Y′ integral. SY4 handles the fine-label factor. Normal-degree projection and completed SY5 finite correction give an integral F_o with own-chart error w^(o+c), order w^(o+c) on every other plane, and every prescribed position multidegree. Since p=w², the remaining error is w^(o+2c). This proves the actual outgoing OneSidedLemma4 application for C>=100.
assumptions: Exact actual Type-II frame, coefficients, chart and one-sided xi hypotheses, with the explicitly stated C>=100 inequalities.
Fine label supported on TT and normal-homogeneous monPh of degree o.
The previously reconstructed SY4 and SY5 key construction and finite correction.
